title: Foiled review queue item
description: One analyst review queue item (#35): a pending CVE or technique link, a pre-disclosure candidate, an IOC publication candidate, a campaign label or merge proposal, false-positive feedback, an actor possible-association or a write-up in review, with its stored analyst state, SLA and priority. Mirrored by foiled_core::review::ReviewItem. See docs/review-queue.md.

target.description: CVE id, technique id or actor label.

other_campaign_id.description: campaign_merge: the campaign to fold into campaign_id.

revision.description: actor_association: a confirmed link that needs another look because attempts joined it since (#29).

submitted_at.description: Write-up items: when it was submitted. Each submission is a new item.

status.description: needs_attention: a decision did not finish or its rollback failed; shown first, and can be decided again after a minute.

priority.description: Higher first. Zero for snoozed and decided items.

version.description: Pass back as expected_version to act on the item.
